text:
Maria: Hey team — running into flaky logs in the onboarding sampleapp. Sometimes we get DEBUG lines with request-id, sometimes only INFO without request-id. It feels tied to OpenTelemetry hook ordering during SDK init. Anyone seen this?
Alex: Node sample? Can you paste init sequence + env?
Maria: Node. Sequence: install SDK -> require('redwood-sdk') -> configure logger -> init otel hooks -> start server. Env: LOG_LEVEL=info, REDWOOD_OTEL=1. Repro: npm start, hit /health a few times. Minimal logs below.
Maria: ```
INFO Server starting
DEBUG otel:hook:init registering hooks
INFO request handled route=/health
DEBUG request-id=abcd1234 trace=00-...
INFO request handled route=/metrics
```
Alex: Looks like logger autoconfig happens lazily after first OTEL callback. Race where req-id middleware isn't wired before logger used.
Sam: Hit same with a new customer. Workaround: force-sync logger init before OTEL hooks: call SDK.initLogger(...) as first user call. Also SDK 1.3.2 fixed an ordering bug.
Maria: Can we patch sampleapp so new users don't hit this?
Alex: Two quick changes: 1) wire request-id middleware before route handlers and any async OTEL exporter; 2) add explicit early logger bootstrap to lock level. Example (top of entry):
Alex: ```js
// early.js - require this at top of main entry
const { initLogger } = require('redwood-sdk');
initLogger({ level: process.env.LOG_LEVEL || 'info' });
const express = require('express');
const app = express();
app.use((req, res, next) => {
  req.id = req.headers['x-request-id'] || Date.now().toString(36);
  process.env.CURRENT_REQUEST_ID = req.id; // used by logger integration
  next();
});
module.exports = app;
```
Sam: Also the SDK's OTEL hook attaches an async exporter that can flip effective log level briefly while registering. We added a guard in 1.3.x to keep level stable until exporter ready. Recommend sampleapp use SDK >=1.3.2 and include early.js pattern.
Maria: Good. Another issue: PII leaking in headers — emails showing up in DEBUG logs sometimes.
Alex: Found a regex mismatch in sample redaction rule; it assumed quotes. Current scrub: `/(\"?\w+@\w+\.\w+\"?)/g` which misses hyphens/dots in local-part. Use SDK redactHeaders option or a better pattern.
Alex: Suggested: `/(?:[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+)@(?:[A-Za-z0-9.-]+)\.[A-Za-z]{2,}/g`
Maria: I'll patch sample and onboarding note: "Bootstrap logger before OTEL hooks, include request-id middleware, prefer SDK >=1.3.2 for stable log levels."
Sam: Add a tiny integration test: start sample with LOG_LEVEL=info and assert no DEBUG lines before request-id assigned. Saved us before. :thumbsup: 
devex-bot: Note: created issue #4822 in devex/samples: "sampleapp: early logger bootstrap + request-id guard + improved redaction regex"
Maria: Thanks — I'll send a PR later today.
Alex: Ping me on the PR and I'll review.
Maria: Will do. Cheers!
